nodes.rationale: اعتُمد تعريف واحد وتاريخ قراءة واحد (٨ أيلول ٢٠٢٦) وأُعلن صراحةً أن أرقام الأوراق الأقدم تخصّ يومها لا اليوم — لتفسير اختلاف الأرقام بين المستندات بدل إخفائه: من اختار ثلاث مناطق وأربعة منتجات له اثنا عشر صفّاً وهو واحد.
nodes.norm_label: تعريف عد المشتركين — عنوان اشعار مميز (12,146) لا صفوف الاشتراك (66,109)

nodes.label: المواطن لا يُسجَّل — لا حساب ولا اسم ولا هاتف
nodes.rationale: أقلّ ما يُجمع هو أقلّ ما يُسرَّب: فتح التطبيق لا ينشئ حساباً، والبيانات الشخصية التي لا تُجمع أصلاً لا تحتاج حماية ولا محواً.
nodes.norm_label: المواطن لا يسجل — لا حساب ولا اسم ولا هاتف

nodes.label: الإفصاح عن الملحق السابق — أسماء أصحاب المحطات وهواتفهم زائدة عن حاجة الإشراف
nodes.rationale: «وما وقع فعلاً يُقال»: أُقرّ بأن الملحق المسلَّم سابقاً تضمّن بيانات تواصل لا يقتضيها الإشراف، وعولج الأمر بإفراد حساب متابعة لا يُخرج إلا أعداداً مجمَّعة — تصحيح بنيوي لا اعتذار لفظي.
nodes.norm_label: الافصاح عن الملحق السابق — اسماء اصحاب المحطات وهواتفهم زايدة عن حاجة الاشراف

nodes.label: سياسة المحو — إلغاء فوري، وأرشيف ثلاثين يوماً، ومهمّة يوميّة مجدولة
nodes.rationale: مقايضة معلنة: الحذف الفوري لعنوان الإشعار عند إلغاء المواطن، مقابل إبقاء نسخة من بيانات المحطة ثلاثين يوماً لاسترجاع ما حُذف بالخطأ — ثمّ تُمحى بمهمّة مجدولة لا بقرار بشري.
nodes.norm_label: سياسة المحو — الغاء فوري، وارشيف ثلاثين يوما، ومهمة يومية مجدولة

nodes.label: سياسات أمان على مستوى الصفّ (RLS) — المنع في القاعدة لا في التطبيق
nodes.rationale: وُضع الحجب داخل قاعدة البيانات نفسها لأن ما يُمنع في الواجهة يُلتَفّ عليه بتغيير واجهة؛ عناوين الإشعارات وجداولها ممنوعة عن كلّ مفتاح عامّ ولا تُقرأ إلا بمفتاح الخدمة داخل الخادم.
nodes.norm_label: سياسات امان على مستوى الصف (rls) — المنع في القاعدة لا في التطبيق

nodes.label: طلب اعتماد المنصة قناةً إلكترونية موحّدة
nodes.rationale: الاعتماد الرسمي يجعل المنصة مساندة لجداول التوزيع التي ينشرها الفرع بدل أن تنافسها؛ الحجّة المقدَّمة هي أداء ميداني مثبت على مدى ٢٤ يوماً لا وعد مستقبلي.
nodes.norm_label: طلب اعتماد المنصة قناة الكترونية موحدة

nodes.label: تعميم على المحطات الحكومية والأهلية بالتسجيل
nodes.rationale: التغطية ناقصة لأن التسجيل طوعي: ٣٧ محطة في ٩ مدن من أصل ٢٧ قضاءً وناحية، و٠ محطة حكومية. التعميم الإداري هو الرافعة الوحيدة التي تسدّ الفجوة، والتسجيل مجاني ولا يستغرق دقائق فلا كلفة تمنع الامتثال.
nodes.norm_label: تعميم على المحطات الحكومية والاهلية بالتسجيل

nodes.label: تسمية ضابط ارتباط ولوحة متابعة للفرع
nodes.rationale: ضابط الارتباط يوثّق صحة بيانات المحطات المسجّلة (تحقّق من جهة رسمية بدل الاعتماد على إقرار صاحب المحطة وحده)، واللوحة تُجهَّز عند الطلب وبلا كلفة لإزالة عائق الميزانية.
nodes.norm_label: تسمية ضابط ارتباط ولوحة متابعة للفرع

nodes.label: مصدر المعلومة صاحب المحطة نفسه
nodes.rationale: التحديث بضغطة من هاتف صاحب المحطة يجعل البيانات لحظية بلا فريق ميداني ولا كلفة تشغيل؛ والمقابل أن الدقة تعتمد على أمانة المحدِّث — ولذلك طُلب ضابط ارتباط للتوثيق.

nodes.label: إبراز المناطق التي فيها منتظرون ولا محطة معتمدة
nodes.rationale: تُحوَّل بيانات الاشتراك إلى مؤشر طلب غير ملبّى يخصّ قرارات التغطية لدى قسم الدراسات — وهو الاستعمال الرسمي الوحيد المقترح لأرقام المشتركين المجمَّعة.
nodes.norm_label: ابراز المناطق التي فيها منتظرون ولا محطة معتمدة

nodes.label: حساب باسم الجهة لا باسم شخص (anbar1)
nodes.rationale: الحساب المؤسسي يبقى قائماً إذا نُقل الموظّف، فلا ينقطع الاطّلاع بتغيير الملاك؛ والمقايضة أن الاعتماد مشترك، وعولجت بإتاحة تبديل كلمة المرور بطلب في دقيقة.
nodes.norm_label: حساب باسم الجهة لا باسم شخص (anbar1)

nodes.label: حدود الصلاحية — قراءة فقط، بلا بيانات شخصية، وسحب فوري
nodes.rationale: لا زرّ واحد يغيّر بيانات، ولا أرقام هواتف أصحاب المحطات ولا عناوين إشعار — والحجب على مستوى قاعدة البيانات لا الواجهة «فلا يظهر بأي طريق»، أي أن الضمان تقنيّ لا وعد إداريّ.
nodes.norm_label: حدود الصلاحية — قراءة فقط، بلا بيانات شخصية، وسحب فوري

nodes.label: Benefits Offered to the Directorate
nodes.rationale: A digital extension of the daily distribution tables, self-distributing congestion relief, fewer inbound calls, a live field picture showing which stations announced availability and when each last updated, an indicator of supply regularity per city, and no cost or financial commitment on the directorate.

nodes.label: Anticipated Questions Box
nodes.rationale: Liability rests with the station owner who enters the data, shown with a last-updated timestamp; a per-station report button reaches administration and a repeatedly inaccurate station can be delisted; no special hardware or internet is needed; and there are no fees on stations or citizens.

nodes.label: أحمد الرفاعي — Platform Originator and Supervisor
nodes.norm_label: احمد الرفاعي — platform originator and supervisor

nodes.label: Two Requests to the Channel
nodes.rationale: Announce the app launch once both stores finish publishing, and invite station owners across the province to register free of charge; supporting material in text, images or video is offered in whatever form and timing suits the channel.

nodes.label: Three Requests to the Directorate
nodes.rationale: Adopt the service as a supporting electronic channel alongside the daily distribution tables, circulate a directive to public and private stations to register and keep availability current (accuracy of the service follows from the accuracy of what stations enter), and name a liaison officer with a monitoring dashboard placed at the directorate's disposal.

nodes.label: Letter to Al-Deera Satellite Channel
nodes.rationale: Thanks the channel as the first outlet to introduce the platform to the province and asks it to finish what it started, because the message that still has to reach station owners themselves is the one the team cannot deliver alone.

nodes.label: Official Letter to Anbar Oil Products Distribution
nodes.norm_label: official letter to anbar oil products distribution

nodes.label: Admin Approval and Phone Verification Gate
nodes.rationale: No station is published without review by platform administration and a phone confirmation of its owner, so nobody can register a station that is not theirs or publish data under an existing station's name.
nodes.norm_label: admin approval and phone verification gate

nodes.label: Three-Step Operating Flow
nodes.rationale: The station registers once, its supervisor toggles availability from an ordinary phone with no software, hardware or training, and the citizen sees the state immediately sorted by proximity with a one-tap route via Google Maps or Waze.

nodes.label: Owner Guide Step Sequence
nodes.rationale: Title, signing in, phone number and password, the «لوحة محطتي» dashboard, the products panel, confirming availability, congestion, the daily update habit, the shareable availability image carrying station name, available products and date, the station link, and the closing card.

nodes.label: Environment Variables and VAPID Keys
nodes.rationale: The anon key is safe to expose because RLS protects it; the service role key is server-only and used for sending notifications.

nodes.label: Three Roles: Driver, Station Owner, Admin
nodes.rationale: Drivers browse, filter, vote and subscribe with no account at all; owners manage their station at /owner; admins approve or reject stations at /admin. A station is invisible to users until admin approval.
nodes.norm_label: three roles: driver, station owner, admin

nodes.label: Tech Stack (Next.js 16, Supabase, Leaflet, Web Push)
nodes.rationale: Leaflet plus OpenStreetMap is chosen so the map needs no paid keys; the service worker is hand-written for offline use and notifications.
nodes.norm_label: tech stack (next.js 16, supabase, leaflet, web push)

nodes.label: .nojekyll Guard
nodes.rationale: Without touching out/.nojekyll, GitHub Pages runs Jekyll and drops every _next/* asset.

nodes.label: Static Export to GitHub Pages
nodes.rationale: Free, unlimited deploys and reachable from Iraq. Everything dynamic runs in Supabase, so the site itself is just files.

nodes.label: stations-changed Repository Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Station approvals fire a repository_dispatch so a newly approved station gets its own statically generated page without a manual redeploy.

nodes.norm_label: main_d — هندسة مسار الرمادي ← منفذ عرعر

nodes.label: CapApp-SPM Dependency Host Package
nodes.rationale: Generated package that hosts SPM dependencies for the Capacitor project; explicitly not to be modified by hand.

nodes.label: Capacitor WebView Shell (Android)
nodes.rationale: Replaced the Trusted Web Activity build: a TWA renders through Chrome, so on a phone whose browser does not support it Android asks the user to pick a browser, which is not an app experience. A WebView never does that, and site updates still reach users instantly because the shell only loads the URL.

nodes.label: App Store Connect API Key Signing
nodes.rationale: Signing uses an App Store Connect API key rather than a checked-in certificate; -allowProvisioningUpdates lets Xcode create the distribution certificate and provisioning profile on the runner, so there is no .p12 to store, rotate, or leak. The decoded key is PEM-checked because a truncated secret produces a confusing signing failure much later.
nodes.norm_label: app store connect api key signing

nodes.label: Newest Xcode Selection
nodes.rationale: App Store Connect rejects anything built with an older SDK and the runner image's default Xcode is not always its newest, so the job picks the highest installed rather than pinning a version that ages out of the image; an SDK older than iOS 26 fails the build early.

nodes.label: Run Number as CFBundleVersion
nodes.rationale: Every upload needs a build number higher than the last one App Store Connect saw; the GitHub run number is monotonic and needs no bookkeeping.

nodes.label: WKWebView Shell (iOS)
nodes.rationale: Same idea as the Android build: a shell around muhta.online. Apple requires macOS to compile and sign, and GitHub's macOS runners are free for public repositories, so no Mac is needed anywhere in the project.

nodes.label: Problem Statement Table
nodes.rationale: Four causes and their consequences: citizens learn availability only by asking or trying, information spreads verbally and through social groups, congestion is unevenly distributed, and calls flood the directorate and stations daily over something published information would settle.

nodes.label: Nine-Scene Explainer Sequence
nodes.rationale: The daily question, the cost of the late answer (an hour, a litre, a stale post), the information already existing with the station owner but having no road to the people, one tap building that road, delivery to whoever chose their city and fuel, wholly free, an invitation addressed to both owner and user, the name and slogan, and the QR codes filmed straight off the screen.

nodes.label: Explainer Video Stage (explainer.html)
nodes.rationale: Screen-recorded rather than exported from an editor: a fixed 1920x1080 stage scaled to fill the window, with all timing expressed as animation-delay on one shared timeline, so changing a scene means changing two numbers. R restarts, F fullscreens, space pauses.

nodes.label: Station Owner Guide Video (guide.html)
nodes.rationale: Nine steps at about eight seconds each with no voiceover, because the pacing is measured for reading rather than listening: one step on screen, one sentence, and a picture of exactly what the owner will see when he opens his phone. It reuses the same stage as explainer.html so the same capture script renders it to MP4 in both sizes.

nodes.label: Two Aspect Ratios From One File
nodes.rationale: The wide cut for the channel and Facebook and the vertical cut for stories come from the same document via ?v=story or the V key, because two separate files would diverge at the first edit.
nodes.norm_label: two aspect ratios from one file

nodes.label: Persistent Brand Band
nodes.rationale: Scenes end at the edge of the bottom band rather than running under it: making the mark opaque above the content hid the overlap instead of preventing it, and a phone edge disappearing behind a card reads as a design mistake. The band is part of the layout and each scene centres in what is left above it.

nodes.label: QR Legibility Under Video Compression
nodes.rationale: Codes are drawn at 340px inside a 1920 frame so the densest 53-module code still lands about 3.4 pixels per module when watched at 1080 wide on a phone; 270px would drop it to 2.5 and make it a gamble on video compression. The code itself is inked rather than green because green on white is about 3.9:1 contrast, enough on paper but not necessarily after compression and broadcast colour shift.

nodes.label: Four-Phase Expansion Plan
nodes.rationale: Phase one Ramadi (in progress), phase two Fallujah, Hit, Habbaniyah, Khalidiyah, Amiriyat al-Fallujah and Karma, phase three the remaining western cities, phase four a monitoring dashboard and periodic reports on availability regularity per city.

nodes.label: 12-Tester Closed Testing Requirement
nodes.rationale: Individual developer accounts created after November 2023 must run closed testing with 12 testers for 14 days before public release; company accounts and older accounts are exempt.

nodes.label: Play Data Safety Declaration
nodes.rationale: Approximate location is declared as not collected because it is used on-device only to sort stations and never sent to the server; name and phone are collected for station owners only, congestion colour votes count as user-generated content, and the notification identifier as a device ID.

nodes.label: Data and Privacy Stance
nodes.rationale: No account, name or phone number is asked of a citizen to browse; no personal data is gathered and no movement tracked, with location used on the citizen's own device only to sort by proximity. What is published is station data as a service facility, all of it declared willingly by the owner.

nodes.label: Reviewer Demo Station Account
nodes.rationale: The reviewer needs an account to see the station-owner dashboard, otherwise only the public interface is visible; the demo account must exist before submission or the app is rejected.

nodes.label: App Name Without the Province
nodes.rationale: The name omits «الأنبار» because the name is fixed in the user's mind while expansion to the rest of Iraq cannot carry a name that confines the platform to one province; Anbar stays in the description, which can be edited any time.

nodes.label: Package Name online.muhta.app
nodes.rationale: Immutable after creation and must match the AAB file, the Firebase project and assetlinks.json.

nodes.label: AAB Bundle Artifact
nodes.rationale: Google Play accepts only the bundle format for new apps, so the build produces muhta.aab alongside the sideloadable muhta.apk.

nodes.label: APK Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Android refuses to install an unsigned package, so apksigner proves the artifact is signed inside CI rather than the failure being discovered on a user's phone.

nodes.label: Firebase Config Restore Step
nodes.rationale: google-services.json is kept out of the public repo, so it is base64-restored from a secret before the Gradle plugin looks for it; without it the app builds fine but never receives a device token.
